notes: Clean-source refresh 2026-07-01: cut @2500s, lowpass 2.8kHz (distance) of the source recording, stereo, 48 kHz, loudnorm I=-20 LUFS TP=-1.0. FLAC intermediate; loopify-scenes.py trims to the element's prime loopOffset and encodes Opus. Seamless-looped to 409s (prime loopOffset) for native Howler looping: 6s fade-wrap of the post-loop tail over the head so the loop point is gapless. Encoded as Opus (128k) — see DECISIONS.md 'Ship scene audio as Opus, not MP3'.
